name: Everything is a win when the goal is experience (Substack essay)
author: maeve (bymaevelle)
why: The 'goal is experience' reframe is sharable content fodder for the athlete-platform audience and a useful founder mindset for high-variance bets.

name: Reframe goals around experience, not perfection — stop comparing your full reality to others' highlight reels
